prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” roofing company that fits every homeowner — the right choice depends on your location in Dallas, roof type, budget, insurance involvement, and whether you want a premium warranty or fastest timeline. I can help you find the best contractor for your situation, but first here are practical steps, what to look for, and some red flags.

How to pick the best Dallas roofer
- Verify credentials
  - Proof of insurance (liability and workers’ comp). Ask to see certificates.
  - Manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed Master Shingle Applicator, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred). These matter for extended warranties.
  - Local business license and any required Texas registrations.
- Experience & reputation
  - At least several years’ experience with local Dallas weather (wind, hail).
  - Check recent reviews on Google, Yelp, BBB, and contractor platforms (Angi/HomeAdvisor).
  - Ask for 3 local references and photos of recent full replacements.
- Written details & warranties
  - Get a detailed written estimate: scope, materials (brand/model), removal of old roof, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, permit handling, cleanup, timeline, payment schedule.
  - Ask about workmanship warranty and manufacturer warranty transferability.
- Insurance & storm claims
  - If filing an insurance claim, confirm the roofer will work with your insurer and provide documentation (shingle samples, photos, inspection report).
  - Beware contractors who pressure you to sign over your check or guarantee an insurer’s payment.
- Price vs value
  - Get at least 3 estimates. Extremely low bids often indicate shortcuts; extremely high bids aren’t automatically better.
- Red flags
  - High-pressure sales (storm chasers), cash-only deals, no written contract, poor or no references, push to sign immediately, offers to waive permits.

Where to look for contractors in Dallas
- Google Reviews / Yelp / BBB
- Angi, HomeAdvisor
- Manufacturer locators (e.g., GAF, Owens Corning find-a-contractor)
- Local Facebook community pages and Nextdoor for recent homeowner experiences

If you want, I can:
- Pull together a short list (3–5) of highly rated roofers near your address/ZIP code
- Compare estimates if you have them
- Provide a script of questions to ask when you call

Tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood), roof type (asphalt shingle, tile, metal), and whether you’re using insurance — I’ll find top local options and summarize ratings and warranties for you.
